title: Extendable Ladder
body:
"Can be used to access special places all across the map! This ladder can extend / shrink down, please note that you may need to drag the ladder after extending!"

The Extendable Ladder is an object that can be purchased from The Oak Depot for $1250. It is a portable ladder.

Details

The Extendable Ladder is a bulky portable ladder. When purchased, it comes in its collapsed form. Interacting with the ladder causes it to extend or retract based on its current state. Due to this functionality being driven by physics constraints, however, the Extendable Ladder does not properly weld to truck beds, and will slide around while moving.

While the Extendable Ladder is typically used as a ladder, it can also be used to bridge gaps, such as those in the Magma Caves. This can make harvesting Magma Trees much safer.
